description: This file defines a class MyReviewMenuConfigurator that implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is used to configure menu items for the performance review section in the OrangeHRM application, correctly overriding the screen for the 'myPerformanceReview' module.

classes.name: MyReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the performance review menu, overriding the current screen to 'myPerformanceReview'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'myPerformanceReview' for the current module and screen context, using a trait method.
